name: MAX485
notes: RS485 transceiver, single 5V supply (4.75 to 5.25 V). DIP8: 1 RO receiver output, 2 RE receiver enable ACTIVE LOW, 3 DE driver enable ACTIVE HIGH, 4 DI driver input, 5 GND, 6 A non-inverting bus, 7 B inverting bus, 8 VCC. DE high: A follows DI and B is opposite; DE low: A and B high impedance. RE low: RO high when A-B >= +0.2 V, low when A-B <= -0.2 V; RE high: RO high impedance. A and B are bidirectional bus pins. Typical use needs a 120 ohm termination between A and B at the bus ends and a 100 nF decoupling capacitor at VCC.
spice:
.subckt CHIP_MAX485 ro re de di gnd a b vcc
Rs vcc gnd 2k
Rin a b 12k
Bro ro gnd I = (v(ro,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step(v(a,b),40))/20*(1-lunes_step(v(re,gnd)-1.5,20))
Bda a gnd I = (v(a,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step(v(di,gnd)-1.5,20))/30*lunes_step(v(de,gnd)-1.5,20)
Bdb b gnd I = (v(b,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)*(1-lunes_step(v(di,gnd)-1.5,20)))/30*lunes_step(v(de,gnd)-1.5,20)
.ends CHIP_MAX485
